QuestInfo.name: [Lv. 300 Achievement] Symbol of Grand Honor
QuestInfo.0: You hear Cygnus's voice from somewhere. You should focus your mind.
QuestInfo.1:
Was #bCygnus#k's voice just an illusion?

Speak with Neinheart via the #bQuest Notifier on the left side of the screen#k.
QuestInfo.2:
Neinheart asked you, on behalf of Empress Cygnus, to continue being their light of hope.

He then presented you with the #b#i3014047# #t3014047##k, hoping that you'd be a guide for other heroes to come.
